note: Reitit (data-driven route vectors, nested string-prefix composition, 2 levels deep) + a bare Ring 1-arity handler with no router attached (ring-only-handler) also surfaced as its own http entry point. Unlike Compojure, Reitit's :middleware is declared INSIDE the route's own method map, so it IS per-route attributable — POST /api/users carries wrap-auth and is emitted authenticated:true (honest, evidence-based, unlike Compojure's necessarily-false whole-handler Ring middleware).
